title: Layer-wise Swapping for Generalizable Multilingual Safety

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the safety alignment and unsafety ratios of large language models across high-resource (English) and low-resource languages (Korean, Bengali, Swahili, Telugu) using the multilingual MultiJail benchmark to identify and mitigate linguistic disparities.

Measuring the model's propensity to generate unsafe responses by evaluating its performance on specific adversarial prompt categories, including discrimination and hate speech, from the MultiJail safety benchmark.
